settings.visualStyle: Grounded cinematic first-person WWII jungle-hill realism at Kohima, India, April 1944. British-Indian infantry POV, steep ridges, monsoon humidity, trench lines, shattered gardens, red earth and the famous tennis-court sector represented without copying archival framing. Non-graphic and physically restrained.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds. No spoken dialogue, narrator or intelligible speech. Nearby friendlies remain British-Indian forces; Japanese defenders remain clearly separated in opposing trenches and ridge approaches. Use exhaustion, terrain and waiting between short danger beats.
settings.customVisualStyle: Photorealistic first-person hill-defense reenactment with red soil, damp leaves, sweat, steep steps, trench texture, body-weight movement and cinematic reveals.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP12 — Kohima: Ridge Under Siege
movie.storySummary: A fictional British-Indian infantry soldier carries supplies up the ridge, moves through defensive trenches near the tennis-court sector, endures a tense night and sees dawn over battered Kohima positions.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Focus on steep terrain, red soil, humidity, trench fatigue and compressed defensive space. No dialogue or narration.

scenes.title: Up the Ridge
scenes.actionDescription: He climbs steep red-earth steps carrying a supply bundle.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person British-Indian uniform sleeves, red soil steps, pack and bundle, friendly troops above.
scenes.videoPrompt: Heavy uphill climb. Audio: boots, insects, breath, distant guns.

scenes.title: Water on the Face
scenes.actionDescription: He wipes sweat and rain from face while leaning on a timber post.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person wet glove, timber, green hillside, rifle slung.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow wipe and exhale. Audio: insects, drip, breath.

scenes.title: Supply Trench
scenes.actionDescription: He lowers the supply bundle into a narrow friendly trench.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hands lowering canvas bundle to British-Indian troops, red mud walls.
scenes.videoPrompt: One controlled handoff. Audio: canvas, mud, distant artillery.

scenes.title: Garden Wall
scenes.actionDescription: He crouches behind a shattered garden wall and scans opposite slope.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person broken masonry, damaged garden, opposing ridge separate in distance, rifle low.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low scan. Audio: birds, distant bursts, breath.

scenes.title: Court Lines
scenes.actionDescription: He glances down at fragments of old court surface beside trench edge.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person worn court markings, red soil and trench timbers, no staged archival recreation.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow downward look and hold. Audio: wind, insects, distant battle.

scenes.title: Short Crawl
scenes.actionDescription: He crawls a few meters along low cover to another trench bay.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person muddy elbows, low wall, rifle beside body, friendly cover ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low crawl then stop. Audio: mud, cloth, breath, distant shots.

scenes.title: Quiet Ration
scenes.actionDescription: He eats a small ration with hands while seated in trench.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person ration tin, muddy fingers, timber wall, rifle resting safely nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mostly still. Audio: tin, insects, distant artillery.

scenes.title: Dusk Fog
scenes.actionDescription: He watches mist thicken across opposing ridge.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person ridge edge, gray mist, friendly trench foreground, no enemy visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow hold as mist thickens. Audio: insects, wind, breath.

scenes.title: Night Flare
scenes.actionDescription: A flare reveals distant movement on opposing approach and he lowers behind trench.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person flare-lit ridge, separated enemy-side movement far away, friendly trench foreground.
scenes.videoPrompt: Brief rise, distant reveal, quick duck. Audio: flare hiss, distant bursts, breath.

scenes.title: Hold Low
scenes.actionDescription: He keeps low with both hands steady on rifle but does not fire.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person rifle low across knees, muddy trench, flare fading.
scenes.videoPrompt: Near-still tension. Audio: distant fire, breath, insects returning.

scenes.title: Rain Returns
scenes.actionDescription: Rain fills small puddles and he pulls poncho edge over gear.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person wet poncho, muddy hands, trench puddles.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cover gear with poncho. Audio: rain, fabric, distant guns.

scenes.title: Ammo Pass
scenes.actionDescription: He passes ammunition down the friendly trench hand-to-hand.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person ammunition bundle moving between British-Indian sleeves.
scenes.videoPrompt: One handoff sequence. Audio: metal, canvas, rain.

scenes.title: First Birds
scenes.actionDescription: At dawn he slowly raises above trench as birds begin again.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person pale dawn, wet ridge, friendly trenches, mist lifting.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow rise to dawn. Audio: birds, drip, breath.

scenes.title: Battered Garden
scenes.actionDescription: He looks across the damaged garden and court area in morning light.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person battered trees, wall fragments and old court surface, no celebratory pose.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pan across aftermath. Audio: birds, wind, distant guns.

scenes.title: Still on the Ridge
scenes.actionDescription: He retightens his pack and returns down into the trench line.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hands tightening pack strap, friendly trench ahead, morning haze.
scenes.videoPrompt: Strap pull and step down. Audio: gear, mud, tired breath. Fade.

characters.name: POV Soldier
characters.description: Anonymous British-Indian infantry defender at Kohima, 1944.
characters.mainOutfit: British-pattern tropical field uniform, steel helmet, web gear, service rifle

continuity.continuityRules: Nearby friendlies remain British-Indian forces. Japanese defenders remain clearly separate. Preserve mud, wetness, fatigue and ridge-position continuity.

atmosphereAssets.description: Damaged garden, old court surface and trench lines.

atmosphereAssets.title: Defensive Ridge
atmosphereAssets.description: British-Indian trench line facing separated Japanese approaches.
